solved_invariants: Current household records have deterministic semantic addresses from offer_id, listing_id, or candidate_id; titles and prices are never identities.
SELECT, DIFF, COMPARE, WHY, PROVE, ROUTE, PROJECT, and RECONCILE execute deterministically through the shell adapter.
Live AddressPlane routing selected only the built BonfyreQuery owner: 1 survivor from 87 current command advertisements.
Live RECONCILE refused to merge two distinct housing observations lacking a canonical join.
body.summary: Implemented and live-exercised the AddressPlane-backed shell operator over current household state. It selected eight dog-flagged housing observations, routed BonfyreQuery, compared/diffed two observations, projected fields, explained provenance, failed availability proof closed, and persisted a reconciliation receipt (SHA-256 7aeb4f41cbcc034905a18b5e696d200ae6c18f354dcf71f07d20a25b8d5c3fc9).
